name: Kikakuka Library
description: Kikakuka footprints and their supporting 3D models.
description_full: A KiCad library for Kikakuka workflows. It provides the CouplerFixed, CouplerMoving, and CouplerAt footprints used by FreekiCAD assembly alignment, their optional helper 3D models, a unit-cube placeholder model, and the Variable and StringTemplate footprints used by the Fabrication Planner.
